title: A problem with finow-q1-pro watch for dexcomg6
symptom: Using a finow-q1-pro watch as a collector for a Dexcom G6, the capture rate is low with many disconnections despite using the native algorithm. Additionally, a second follower (Huawei pro 30) is not connected although it was added as a follower in the watch.
evidence_quote: The capture rate is low with alot of disconnections although iam using the native algorithm
